name: e3x_v2
scope_rule: Recorded on 2026-09-25, after the e3x_v2 explore run and before any validation number of an exploration candidate was computed. At the user's request, confirm evaluates on validation the selected candidate and every e3x_v2 candidate whose mean CV ROC AUC on train is at least cv_floor (196 candidates), instead of the selected candidate alone. Consequence: once several candidates are read on validation, choosing among them by their validation result makes validation a selection set; the validation result of the candidate so chosen is biased upward and is not reported as its expected performance. The selected candidate of the train rule is reported first and apart. Every candidate is compared with both references; Holm runs over all ROC AUC comparisons together. The test split stays unread; the one candidate carried to it is chosen and dated before test is read
comparison_rule: paired hearing bootstrap on validation (the same replicates for both sides), delta = selected minus reference for ROC AUC and Cohen kappa; two-sided p-value 2 x the smaller share at or beyond zero with the (k + 1) / (B + 1) correction, capped at 1; Holm over the ROC AUC comparisons against the two references
label_semantics: label_inferable is True when the annotator judged the opinion inferable from the four retrieved chunks (retrieved_context_entailment); it says nothing about text outside those chunks and is not a global truth label
